```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
setwd(dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path))
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("ScanRecords.csv")
```

```{r}
df_split <- split(df, df$PatientType)
type_1_df <- df_split$`Type 1`
type_2_df <- df_split$`Type 2`
```

```{r}
summary(df)
```
```{r}
summary(type_1_df)
```
```{r}
summary(type_2_df)
```
# Scan Duration

```{r}
print(
ggplot(type_1_df, aes(x = Duration)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 50, fill = "lightblue", color = "white") +
  
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, 
                args = list(mean = mean(type_1_df$Duration), sd = sd(type_1_df$Duration)), 
                color = "darkred", linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  labs(title = "Histogram of Type 1 Patients Scan Duration",
       x = "Duration",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
)

cat("--- Summary Statistics ---\n")
cat("Mean:", mean(type_1_df$Duration), "\n")
cat("Variance:", var(type_1_df$Duration), "\n")
```

```{r}
ggplot(type_2_df, aes(x = Duration)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 50, fill = "lightblue", color = "white") +
  
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, 
                args = list(mean = mean(type_2_df$Duration), sd = sd(type_2_df$Duration)), 
                color = "darkred", linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  labs(title = "Histogram of Type 2 Patients Scan Duration",
       x = "Duration",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```
# Patient per Date

```{r}
type_1_day_counts <- as.data.frame(table(type_1_df$Date))


lambda_val <- mean(type_1_day_counts$Freq)

ggplot(type_1_day_counts, aes(x = Freq)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = 1, fill = "lightblue", color = "white") +
  
  stat_function(fun = function(x) dpois(floor(x), lambda = lambda_val), 
                color = "darkred", linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  labs(title = "Histogram with Poisson Distribution Fit",
       x = "Frequency",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```
